newsitem.title: FRANCE: Saudi Arabia seen shopping for barley in April.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia seen shopping for barley in April.

text.p: Saudi Arabia, the world's largest barley importer, may shop again for feed barley from mid-April, European grain exporters said on Wednesday.
"Saudi Arabia is not expected to be back before the second half of April," one exporter said.
Another exporter said Saudi Arabia was not expected on the world market "for six weeks".
He said the Saudis were in contact with some exporters but that their buying plans were still "unclear".
"They may buy 500,000 tonnes, one million tonnes," he said, commenting on Saudi Arabia's import requirements.
In January Saudi Arabia bought 1.2 million tonnes of optional-origin barley for February and March delivery.
